parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an inquiry classifier for a fictional property developer.

Classify each inquiry and extract structured details. Respond ONLY with valid JSON matching this exact structure:

{
  "category": "booking" | "vip_card" | "careers" | "general",
  "priority": "high" | "low",
  "summary": "one sentence summarizing the inquiry",
  "extracted": {
    "name": "string or null",
    "email": "string or null",
    "phone": "string or null",
    "property_interest": "string or null",
    "timeline": "string or null"
  }
}

Rules for category:
- "booking" = reservation requests, viewing schedules, unit availability
- "vip_card" = VIP card questions, membership tiers, loyalty program
- "careers" = job applications, internship inquiries
- "general" = anything else

Rules for priority:
- "high" = booking inquiries OR vip_card inquiries
- "low" = careers OR general inquiries

Extract only fields mentioned in the inquiry. Use null for fields not provided."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Classify this inquiry:

{{ $json.body.inquiry }}"
    }
  ],
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "temperature": 0.1
}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO inquiries (
  inquiry, category, priority, summary,
  extracted_name, extracted_email, extracted_phone,
  extracted_property, extracted_timeline,
  draft_reply, retrieved_sources
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.inquiry.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.category }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.priority }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.extracted_name || "" }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.extracted_email || "" }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.extracted_phone || "" }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.extracted_property.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.extracted_timeline || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.choices[0].message.content.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  ARRAY[{{ $('Retrieve FAQ Chunks').all().map(i => i.json.source).filter(Boolean).map(s => `'${s.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`).join(',') }}]::text[]
);
